_comment: Which page reads which published output, and what every output nobody
reads is for. scripts/surface_audit.py checks this against the page code
and the tracked files under data/processed, data/db and data/snapshots:
an output no page reads and no entry explains is a finding, and so is an
entry for a file that is gone or a read the page code no longer makes.
Ported in spirit from pricephillips/data-center-map visibility_audit.py

national-dashboard.js.what: The dashboard (national-dashboard.html): national, state and county views, explorer, record pages, coverage, downloads, data dictionary and SQL console.

prefixes.data/db/state/: one detail file per state, chosen by the route
prefixes.data/db/parquet/: every file data/db/manifest.json lists: the downloads page and the SQL console's tables

processed-data.js.what: The shared loader for data/processed/ used by map-audit.html (the internal geography audit).

downloads._what: Published for people and other programs to fetch; no page loads them.
downloads.data/processed/restrictions.csv: the restrictions table; the JSON twin feeds map-audit
downloads.data/processed/siting_standards.csv: NREL ordinance features; the Parquet copy feeds the SQL console
downloads.data/processed/siting_standards.json: the same, one record per line
downloads.data/processed/state_policies.csv: state siting law; the Parquet copy feeds the SQL console
downloads.data/processed/county_summary.csv: one row per county; the dashboard reads data/db/county_summary.json instead
downloads.data/processed/county_summary.json: the same, one record per line
downloads.data/processed/sources.csv: one row per source document with its archive snapshot
downloads.data/processed/sources.json: the same, one record per line
downloads.data/processed/datapackage.json: the Frictionless data package: every table, its fields and what they mean
downloads.data/processed/headline_metrics.md: the headline numbers as prose; the JSON twin feeds the pages
downloads.data/snapshots/headline_history.csv: the headline figures by day; the dashboard reads data/db/history.json, built from it

internal._what: For reviewers and the Actions summary; never loaded by a page and not a deliverable.
internal.data/processed/qc_report.md: QC findings by code and the quarantine table with release actions
internal.data/processed/diff_summary.md: what the last build changed, keyed on id
internal.data/processed/coverage_delta.md: column fill rates against the previous commit
internal.data/processed/operations_summary.json: what the pipeline did and holds; a page may read it later
internal.data/processed/state_policies_held.csv: state policy rows held back, with the reason
internal.data/processed/negative_checks.csv: the negative checks the last build validated, which build_database.py reads; pages read data/db/ instead
internal.data/processed/county_typology.csv: one category per county read off the published data (scripts/county_typology.py); the county-analyst agent and /analyze-counties read it, no page does yet
